scope: Owner-approved channel workspace read-only vertical MVP; no provider calls, no Git mutation or session scheduling change.

owners.protocol: channel-workspace-browser.ts: strict request/result and persisted workspace tab enum
owners.application: membership/root projection checked before and after Host I/O; no client absolute paths
owners.host: readChannelWorkspace and shared bounded file browser own filesystem/Git reads
owners.frontend: official AgentWorkspace presentation with channel-scoped SDK and abortable UI read state

composition: AgentDetailPanel.tsx workspace branch -> AgentWorkspace.tsx compact/full layout
AgentWorkspace.tsx TreeNode, Markdown renderer and min160/default256/max600 splitter
hooks/useResizablePanel.ts; raft-ui 0.5.64 SegmentedControl and existing theme tokens
provenance.reuse: WorkspaceNativeParts structurally extracts native TreeNode/Markdown parts, preserves native classes and adds accessible action names; splitter hook is imported unchanged. Local channel API/cache/loading state replaces upstream Agent store/transport. This is not a byte-exact copy of the full upstream workspace.
localChanges: Channel ownership; optional fixed attached-directory selector
Git list/diff as read-only view using native row/selection styles
Abort on unmount/root/file switch; explicit read errors
4000 preview lines, 64 KiB rendered Markdown; no automatic remote Markdown images
Root refresh resets expansion/selection, hidden preference is view-local; no copied-path or modified-date footer in this slice

provenance.reuse: Design reference only; no copied legacy business state or dependency. Current Git HEAD diff is not a model-turn diff.

limits.directory: one level, max1000 returned /2000 inspected, sensitive/link/special entries excluded
limits.git: root must itself be a repository with real .git directory; linked worktrees and nested repository discovery deferred; read-only HEAD-to-worktree combined diff, untracked files versus empty; no stage/unstage/commit/revert; 500 visible changes and512KiB command output,10s timeout; helpers/textconv/fsmonitor disabled
limits.preview: Markdown/raw text and raster images; HTML as source only; workspace PDF/media/structured documents deferred (published-attachment previews unchanged)
limits.history: existing bounded first-page transport retained; accumulating old timeline windows and whole-app initial asset optimization not claimed complete

verification.checks: 12 focused host/ACL/schema/sidebar/source-boundary/intake tests; root and Loom typechecks; workbench build; Chromium+WebKit workspace1440/390 and Chromium persisted tab-order/drag/unknown-write-replay; changed-file formatting/diff
verification.browserFixture: temporary authenticated Core, real filesystem and Git, fake CLI discovery, no model execution

initialChromiumObservation.caveat: completed PerformanceResourceTiming entries at chat-tab-ready in this fixture; not full wire accounting or timing benchmark

verification.lazy: zero workspace API/chunk requests before opening tab; preview/raw switch does not reread; single selected diff only
verification.deployment: pending final safe restart and real-page check
